finding: Revolut worker self-terminates after matching Pocket bootstrap JVMTI library in loaded-library scan

untracedComparison.piPocketSame1013509766: SIGKILL and restart also reproduced before attaching a debugger
untracedComparison.samsungPocket: Repeated SIGKILL and restart observed before attaching a debugger

bootstrapReason: Pocket uses -Xplugin:libopenjdkjvmti.so and -agentpath:/system/lib64/libpocket_zygote_api28.so to append its bootstrap JAR with JVMTI
evidenceMethod: PTRACE syscall tracing across app threads/children; hardware execute breakpoint at failure join; read candidate/match strings; no app instruction/register replacement
limitations: Debugger attachment can affect other checks; traced failure here specifically matched the always-loaded bootstrap JVMTI library
Outer VM runs a different app version and Android release; no claim all other checks are equivalent
Removing this runtime dependency has not been tested as a fix
